Post: A Prayer Chain That Promises a Miracle
PostSummary: Chain posts promise that if you copy, share, or forward a prayer to a set number of people, God will grant a miracle — and imply that breaking the chain invites trouble.
BiblicalResponse: God is not bound by chain letters, and His blessings are not unlocked by forwarding counts. Prayer is real and powerful precisely because it is a child speaking to a Father, not a spell with instructions. Pray the prayer if it is good, share encouragement freely — but never let a post convince you that God's favor depends on your shares.
